about: Log 410 held-out set, written 2026-10-12 before any run of it: two-turn conversations whose second turn adds or corrects a condition (NC: the goal becomes unsupported; PC: it stays or becomes supported), asks a question (QS supported, QN not), starts a separate goal (GS supported, GN not), or only acknowledges (AK, no requirement: a reply that asks for detail is right). Gold follows scripts/capability_sheet.yaml. None of these wordings is in the resolver pre-measure bank.

turns: We want a regulatory network linking TFs to genes, from expression, motif and PPI data on 85 samples.
Those 85 profiles are single cells captured from one organoid.
We have a bipartite TF-gene network and would like it split into modules.
A gene ought to be able to sit in two or three of those modules.

requirements.words: A gene ought to be able to sit in two or three of those modules

turns: We want a partial-correlation network between transcripts and CpG methylation for 66 matched samples.
Our proteomics from the same samples has to be part of that single model too.

requirements.words: Our proteomics from the same samples has to be part of that single model too

turns: We want per-sample TF-gene networks for 45 tumors from expression, motifs and PPI.
We need to know which direction causality runs along each edge.

requirements.words: which direction causality runs along each edge

turns: We want a TF-gene network across 72 samples from expression, motifs and PPI.
The samples form a time course, and the model has to capture how regulation at one time point drives the next.

requirements.words: the model has to capture how regulation at one time point drives the next

turns: We want to split our 160 tumors into subtypes.
We only have their RNA-seq profiles; no mutation calls exist.

requirements.words: We only have their RNA-seq profiles; no mutation calls exist

turns: We want a network of how TFs and miRNAs regulate genes across 58 samples, with motifs, PPI and predicted miRNA targets.
The miRNA links should be estimated from negative correlation with the miRNA levels we measured.

requirements.words: The miRNA links should be estimated from negative correlation with the miRNA levels we measured

turns: We want a co-expression network for every one of our 96 samples.
These samples are spots on one tissue slide, and each spot's network should draw on the spots next to it.

requirements.words: each spot's network should draw on the spots next to it

turns: We want a single TF-gene network for 110 samples from expression, motifs and PPI.
On second thought, we need a separate network per sample.
We want a TF-gene regulatory network from expression, motifs and PPI of 64 samples.
miRNAs should be among the regulators as well; we have predicted target sites for them.

requirements.words: miRNAs should be among the regulators as well

turns: We want a network connecting gene expression with metabolite levels in 92 matched samples.
Every edge also needs a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value.

requirements.words: Every edge also needs a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value

turns: We want a TF-gene network from expression, motifs and PPI of 77 samples.
For each TF we need to see whether it switches its targets on or off.

requirements.words: whether it switches its targets on or off

turns: We want the modules of our bipartite TF-gene network.
Within each module we also want the nodes that are most central to it.

requirements.words: the nodes that are most central to it

turns: We want gene-gene co-expression for 180 samples.
They were sequenced in four batches, and the batch-related part of the co-expression should be pulled apart.

requirements.words: the batch-related part of the co-expression should be pulled apart

turns: We want per-sample TF-gene networks for 52 patients from expression, motifs and PPI.
Could those networks then be related to the patients' survival?
We want the communities of our bipartite TF-gene network.
Could you also contrast them with the communities of a second network from treated cells?

requirements.words: contrast them with the communities of a second network

turns: We want a TF-gene network from expression, motifs and PPI of 66 samples.
Separately, we have somatic mutation calls for 240 tumors and want patient subtypes from them.
We want per-sample TF-gene networks for 40 samples.
Another thing: we'd like guide RNAs designed to knock out the strongest hub TFs.

requirements.words: guide RNAs designed to knock out the strongest hub TFs

turns: We want communities in our bipartite TF-gene network.
